name: endpointId
label: Endpoint or job ID
help: An endpoint ID from Search operations, or a job written as `job:<job id>`, for example `job:people.email.find`.

name: input
label: Input (JSON)
help: The input object. Use the field names that Get an operation lists for this endpoint or job.

name: fallback
label: Try other providers
help: When the first provider finds nothing, looot tries the next provider of the same job. Only the attempts that ran are charged. Works with job IDs only.

name: maxCostUsd
label: Max cost (USD)
help: The most this module may spend across all providers it tries, for example `0.1`. Leave empty for the default cap. Used only when Try other providers is on.

name: wait
label: Wait (seconds)
help: How long to wait for the result, from 0 to 30. A run that takes longer comes back with the status `queued` or `running`; read it later with Get a run.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: The same key with the same input never pays twice. Leave empty and the module builds one from the input and the date.
